name: Document & image redactor
description: Permanently black out or pixelate sensitive areas on a document scan or screenshot. Nothing can be recovered from the exported image.

seo.metaTitle: Document & image redactor — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Permanently black out or pixelate sensitive areas on a document scan or screenshot. Nothing can be recovered from the exported image. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/pdf-redact-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Document & image redactor processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/pdf-redact-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Document & image redactor upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Document & image redactor executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-redact-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Document & image redactor upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Document & image redactor executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-redact-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Document & image redactor?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pdf_redact.json or open /tools/pdf-redact?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Document & image redactor?
